run_type: single recovery attempt after attempt 01 launcher failure
classification: exploratory engineering/interface feasibility; not SQL or JOIN accuracy evidence

predecessor.root_cause: Direct Python invocation did not activate the Conda environment, so PATH omitted its installed Ninja binary.

fixed_hypothesis: The pinned official G-reasoner-34M checkpoint accepts the same five-node synthetic graph and returns finite per-node scores; source inspection predicts custom FK metadata is ignored.
only_change_from_attempt_01: Use conda run to activate the already configured environment and expose the already installed Ninja executable. No package or model changes.

success_criteria.G0_A: Pinned checkpoint loads with feature/input dimensions 1024 and 34640897 parameters; output shape is [1,5] and all values are finite.
success_criteria.G0_B: PyG transfer retains all 8 directed edges, parallel relation roles, inverse pairing, and ordered two-component composite-FK metadata.
success_criteria.G0_C: Record exact equality and maximum absolute output delta after changing only edge_attr and custom FK metadata; delta <= 1e-6 counts as unchanged.
success_criteria.stop: Stop after this single recovery run; preserve any failure without retry under attempt 02.

implementation.difference_from_attempt_01: Only the experiment_id literal differs; the fixture and computation are unchanged.
